jobs.title: Media Affiliation Manager FireArc
jobs.description: Fire-Arc is an innovative, data-driven technology company that develops and publishes multi-platform digital assets. We are growing rapidly and looking for results-oriented people who want to create measurable business impact.As our Media Partnerships Manager, you will own the development and growth of affiliate, publisher and direct-site partnerships across global markets. We are looking for someone who is comfortable owning growth, managing partners and media budgets, making independent decisions and adjusting quickly based on performance.What You’ll DoPartner Acquisition & Management: Identify, recruit and build long-term relationships with high-potential affiliates, direct publishers and strategic partners. Performance Optimization & Data Analysis: Monitor campaign performance, work closely with the analytics team and apply data-driven insights to improve ROI and conversion rates. Business Development & Opportunity Hunting: Research new opportunities and initiate and execute partnerships that increase traffic, engagement and revenue.Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with marketing, product and analytics teams to align priorities and identify cross-channel opportunities.

jobs.title: DevOps Engineer FireArc
jobs.description: Fire-Arc is an innovative, data-driven technology company that develops and publishes multi-platform digital assets. We are growing rapidly and looking for results-oriented people who want to create measurable business impact.As our DevOps Engineer, you will own and optimize our cloud infrastructure, automation, and production reliability in a fast-paced environment.What You’ll Do﻿Design, implement, and maintain scalable, secure, and reliable cloud infrastructure, primarily on AWS, with exposure to GCP as an advantage.Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines to automate application deployments and infrastructure changes; CircleCI experience is preferred.Leverage Generative AI tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, or similar) to accelerate scripting, infrastructure automation, CI/CD configuration, and operational troubleshooting.Automate infrastructure provisioning and management using Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC), primarily Terraform and Terragrunt.Automate configuration management and system provisioning using Ansible.Collaborate with development teams to improve application performance, scalability, and reliability.Troubleshoot and resolve infrastructure, application, and network issues to maintain high availability and reliability.Ensure infrastructure adheres to security best practices and organizational standards.Configure and maintain networking components, including proxies, DNS, load balancers, VPNs, and cloud networking.Continuously evaluate and adopt technologies and practices that improve infrastructure reliability, efficiency, and cost-effectiveness.Implement and maintain monitoring, logging, and alerting solutions to proactively identify and resolve infrastructure and application issues.
